body:
The right cannabis products for fall depend on your plans. A bonfire with friends, a slow lap of the backyard and a quiet movie night call for different formats and doses. Start with the occasion, then pick flavors that fit the season. Everything here is for adults 21 and older, at home or on private property where you're welcome.

## Fall flavors in cannabis: apple, spice and earth

Terpenes shape much of cannabis's aroma. In a 2022 study of lab-tested flower from six states, myrcene, beta-caryophyllene and limonene were the most abundant terpenes on average across about 43,000 samples with terpene data. Their notes suit the season:

- **[Myrcene](/blog/myrcene-terpene/):** earthy, musky and herbal.
- **[Beta-caryophyllene](/blog/caryophyllene-terpene/):** peppery and warm, like a spice rack.
- **Limonene:** bright citrus that lifts richer flavors.

Apple and cider notes show up mostly in flavored edibles and drinks, so check the flavor on the package.

## Apple and fruit edibles: dose and timing

Apple-flavored edibles suit the season. Michigan allows fruit flavors on edibles but bans fruit shapes, so apple-flavored gummies and chews come in simple geometric shapes, never as little apples. An adult-use serving is capped at 10 mg of THC; if you're new, start with part of one.

Edibles are slow. Blood levels peak one to two hours after you eat them, and the effects outlast smoking. Take your serving early in the evening and wait at least two hours before deciding on more.

## Infused drinks for bonfire nights on private property

Cannabis drinks for a bonfire can stand in for a cocktail. In Michigan, drinks are capped at 10 mg of THC per serving and 100 mg per container.

- Pour one serving at a time and sip slowly.
- Stay on private property where you're welcome. Michigan doesn't allow use in public places, and whoever owns the property can say no.
- Skip alcohol that night. In a 2026 trial, edibles combined with alcohol often impaired simulated driving more than either one alone.
- Line up a ride or plan to stay over. Never drive after using cannabis.

For how drinks and edibles compare on timing, see [THC drinks vs. edibles](/blog/thc-drinks-vs-edibles-timing/).

## Mini pre-rolls for a backyard stroll

Mini pre-rolls for fall hold less than a standard joint, which makes them easier to keep small. Light one at home, take a slow walk around the yard and enjoy the color. Keep it off sidewalks, trails and parks, and share only with adults 21 and older.

## Spicy and earthy flower for cozy nights

For a night in with a blanket and a movie, cozy strains with earthy or peppery notes fit the mood. Go by aroma, THC level and your own notes rather than strain type alone, and pack a small bowl. Our list of [cozy fall cannabis activities](/blog/cannabis-activities-for-fall/) has more ideas.

## Vapes with autumn flavor profiles

Vapes make it easy to take a puff or two and stop. Look for profiles described as earthy, spiced or woody, and check whether the terpenes come from cannabis or other plants. Take one puff and wait a few minutes before another.

## A fall wish list: matching cannabis products for fall to your plans

| Plan | Format to consider | Flavor notes | Keep in mind |
|---|---|---|---|
| Bonfire with friends | Infused drink | Apple, cider, citrus | One serving at a time, no alcohol |
| Backyard walk | Mini pre-roll | Pine, citrus | Private property only |
| Movie night in | Flower or vape | Earthy, peppery | A small bowl or a puff or two |
| Slow Sunday at home | Edible | Apple, spice | Peaks one to two hours later |

Selection changes often and varies by store, so browse your store's menu in our [online shop](/shop/) before you visit.

faq.a: There's no official fall list, but earthy, myrcene-rich strains and peppery, caryophyllene-forward ones suit cooler weather. Choose by aroma, THC level and how similar strains have suited you before. Our budtenders can help you compare what's on your store's menu, since selection changes often.

faq.q: Are infused drinks good for a bonfire night?
faq.a: They can be, if you keep it to one measured serving, stay on private property where you're welcome and skip alcohol that night. Michigan caps cannabis drinks at 10 mg of THC per serving. Plan a ride home or stay over, because you should never drive after using cannabis.

faq.q: How long do edibles take for a cozy night in?
faq.a: Plan on a while. Edibles reach peak levels one to two hours after you eat them, and the effects last longer than smoking. Take your serving early in the evening and wait at least two hours before considering more. If you're new, start with less than a full 10 mg serving.
